newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World Development NWI stake diluted.
newsitem.headline: New World Development NWI stake diluted.

text.p: New World Development Co Ltd will see its stake in New World Infrastructure Ltd diluted to 56.91 percent from 62.92 percent following a share placement and new share issue, New World Infrastructure said.

New World Development agreed on Tuesday to place 84 million existing shares in New World Infrastructure to professional or institutional investors at HK$24.30 per share and subscribe to the same amount of new shares at the same price.
The placement shares represent about 10.57 percent of New World Infrastructure's existing share capital, the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
New World Infrastructure said the new issue would raise net proceeds of about HK$2.02 billion.

"It is presently intended that the net proceeds will be used for various projects which the company is currently in preliminary negotiations with a number of different parties, with the balance to be used for general working capital," it added.
New World Infrastructure shares rose HK$0.45 on Tuesday to HK$25.05. New World Development shares fell HK$0.20 to HK$48.60.
